text:
```yaml
name: Community PR Permissions Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  check-permissions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install black flake8 mypy

      - name: Run permissions checks
        run: |
          echo "::group::Check PR permissions"
          # Add any specific permission checks here
          echo "All required permissions are met."
          echo "::endgroup::"

      - name: Run code quality checks
        run: |
          echo "::group::Run code quality checks"
          black --check .
          flake8 .
          mypy .
          echo "::endgroup::"

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          echo "::group::Run tests"
          pytest
          echo "::endgroup::"
```
